articles.title: “₹1 Crore for Beheading MP?”: TMC’s Saayoni Ghosh Alleges Open Death Threat Over Viral BJP Leader
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Trinamool Congress MP Saayoni Ghosh has strongly condemned a viral video in which a local BJP leader from Uttar Pradesh allegedly announced a ₹1 crore reward for her beheading.

body.html:
Trinamool Congress MP Saayoni Ghosh has strongly condemned a viral video in which a local BJP leader from Uttar Pradesh allegedly announced a ₹1 crore reward for her beheading.

The controversy erupted after a protest organised by Hindu groups in Sikandrabad area of Bulandshahr district over an old 2015 social media post linked to Ghosh regarding a Shivling, which protesters claimed insulted Hindu deities.

In the viral video, Dr. Pradeep Dixit, identified as the Sikandrabad Nagar Palika Parishad chairman and a local BJP leader, was allegedly heard announcing a ₹1 crore bounty for anyone who brings Ghosh’s severed head.

Reacting strongly to the alleged threat, Ghosh took to social media platform X and tagged Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union Home Minister Amit Shah and Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla, questioning whether such remarks reflected the BJP’s “Nari Shakti Vandan” slogan on women’s empowerment.

The TMC MP said she was “taken aback” by what she described as an “open death threat” being circulated widely across social media and reported by sections of the mainstream media.

Tagging West Bengal Police, Kolkata Police, Bulandshahr Police and UP Police, Ghosh demanded immediate legal and political action against the BJP leader allegedly seen in the video.

She also stated that she would continue exercising her democratic right to voice dissent “both inside and outside Parliament” and would not be “bullied into silence”.

Ghosh further reiterated her earlier claim that her social media account had been hacked in 2015 when the controversial image was allegedly uploaded.

Meanwhile, Dr. Pradeep Dixit denied making the statement and claimed the viral footage had been manipulated using artificial intelligence tools to defame him.

The BJP also distanced itself from the controversy. BJP district president Vikas Chauhan reportedly stated that if such comments were made, they reflected Dixit’s personal views and not the party’s official position. He added that the BJP does not support derogatory remarks against women.

Leaders from the Congress party also criticised the incident and demanded that an FIR be registered against the accused leader.

articles.title: Jewellery Store Employee Steals ₹1.66 Crore Gold, Then Gets Betrayed by Her Own Partner in Crime
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Ahmedabad City Crime Branch has arrested a woman employee of a jewellery store for allegedly stealing gold ornaments worth more than ₹1.66 crore from a showroom in the city.

body.html:
The Ahmedabad City Crime Branch has arrested a woman employee of a jewellery store for allegedly stealing gold ornaments worth more than ₹1.66 crore from a showroom in the city.

According to officials, the accused, identified as Harshida Rajendrakumar Shetty, 38, allegedly carried out the theft on May 11 at Abhushan Jewellers located inside Gravity Shopping Mall in Ahmedabad’s Nikol area before fleeing the scene.

Following a complaint registered at Nikol Police Station, the Crime Branch formed multiple teams to trace the accused. Investigators reportedly examined nearly 300 CCTV footage clips before tracking down Shetty, a resident of New Naroda.

Police said only a portion of the stolen jewellery worth ₹22.54 lakh has been recovered so far.

During the investigation, officials found that Shetty had allegedly planned the theft along with her accomplice, identified as Mayur Ashokbhai Mali from Vastral. After the theft, the duo reportedly escaped on a motorcycle and travelled through Udaipur and Jaipur before reaching Delhi.

However, police said the plan took a dramatic turn in Delhi when Mali allegedly abandoned Shetty at a hotel and fled with most of the stolen gold ornaments.

Recovered items include a gold bracelet worth ₹9.98 lakh, an eagle-embossed gold ring studded with white stones valued at ₹1.34 lakh, a gold mangalsutra worth ₹7.43 lakh, and a gold chain worth ₹3.62 lakh. Police also recovered a mobile phone from her possession.

The accused has been handed over to Nikol Police Station for further interrogation under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita. Police have launched a search operation to trace the absconding accomplice.

articles.title: “Hospital Gate Locked, Baby Delivered in Park”: Faridabad Govt Hospital Faces Outrage Over Alleged
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of alleged medical negligence from Haryana’s Faridabad has triggered outrage after a pregnant woman was reportedly forced to deliver her baby in the park of a government hospital during the night because the main gate was locked and no medical staff responded to repeated...

body.html:
A shocking case of alleged medical negligence from Haryana’s Faridabad has triggered outrage after a pregnant woman was reportedly forced to deliver her baby in the park of a government hospital during the night because the main gate was locked and no medical staff responded to repeated cries for help.

The disturbing incident took place at the 30-bed First Referral Unit hospital in Sector 3. The woman, identified as Balesh from Badoli village, had been rushed to the hospital after she went into labour.

According to family members, they first reached the hospital’s main gate, only to find it locked. Despite repeatedly knocking and shouting for assistance, no doctor, nurse or hospital employee reportedly came forward to help.

The family later found another gate at the back of the hospital premises and entered in search of emergency support. However, they alleged that even after entering the hospital compound, no medical staff attended to the woman.

As labour pains intensified and no emergency response arrived, the baby was eventually delivered in the hospital park itself with the help of a female relative who had experience handling childbirth. The delivery was reportedly carried out under torchlight before the mother and newborn were shifted inside the hospital.

“My husband and brother-in-law kept shouting for help after entering the hospital premises, but no staff came. By the time help reached us, the delivery had already taken place,” Balesh reportedly said.

The woman later gave birth to her third son.

District Deputy Civil Surgeon Dr Rachna stated that the patient had arrived in a fully dilated condition and delivered within minutes. She said the OPD gate remains shut at night, although another gate was open for emergency services, and described the incident as unfortunate.

Following public outrage, the health department launched an inquiry on the directions of the health minister and the director general of health services.

Officials admitted there were deficiencies in night duty arrangements, particularly regarding the absence of a staff nurse and other employees. Authorities confirmed that two staff members found responsible have been suspended.

The Haryana government has also announced plans to set up a maternal and infant mortality “war room” in the coming months to improve monitoring of pregnant women and strengthen emergency medical response systems.

articles.title: Youths Attack Staff, Smash Machines in Hapur After Fuel Dispute
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident of violence and vandalism was reported late at night at Santosh Filling Station on Kithaur Road in Uttar Pradesh’s Hapur district, where a group of youths allegedly attacked a petrol pump following a dispute over fuel.

body.html:
A shocking incident of violence and vandalism was reported late at night at Santosh Filling Station on Kithaur Road in Uttar Pradesh’s Hapur district, where a group of youths allegedly attacked a petrol pump following a dispute over fuel.

According to reports, the youths got into an argument with a salesman at the petrol pump before launching a violent attack using sticks and stones.

The accused allegedly vandalised the petrol pump premises and damaged fuel dispensing machines, creating panic among employees present at the spot.

The entire incident was captured on CCTV cameras installed at the petrol pump, and the footage is now being examined by police as part of the investigation.

After receiving information about the incident, officials from Hapur Dehat Police Station reached the spot and began an inquiry.

Based on a complaint filed by petrol pump operator Amanveer Narayan Singh Tyagi, police have registered a case and launched a search operation to trace the accused.

Station House Officer Neeraj Kumar said the accused are being identified with the help of CCTV footage and assured that they would be arrested soon. He added that strict legal action will be taken against those involved in the vandalism and assault.

articles.title: “Flower Shower for Rape Accused?”: Viral Rally After Bail of Hindu Yuva Vahini Leader Triggers
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major controversy has erupted in Uttar Pradesh’s Ghaziabad after a former Hindu Yuva Vahini leader, accused in a rape case involving an LLB student, was welcomed with a grand procession following his release from jail on bail.

body.html:
A major controversy has erupted in Uttar Pradesh’s Ghaziabad after a former Hindu Yuva Vahini leader, accused in a rape case involving an LLB student, was welcomed with a grand procession following his release from jail on bail.

The accused, identified as Sushil Prajapati, former Muradnagar city president of the Hindu Yuva Vahini, was released from Ghaziabad district jail on May 17 after spending nearly nine months in custody.

Videos now circulating widely on social media show supporters garlanding him, showering him with flowers, raising slogans and carrying him on their shoulders outside the jail premises. A vehicle rally was also reportedly organised after his release.

The controversy stems from a rape case registered against Prajapati on August 8, 2025, at Muradnagar police station by a 23-year-old LLB student from Modinagar.

According to the complaint, the woman met Prajapati in 2021. She alleged that he frequently contacted her and later offered to help her begin legal practice in Ghaziabad court.

The student alleged that Prajapati took her to a flat in a Thar vehicle on the pretext of introducing her to a senior advocate. She claimed he gave her a cold drink allegedly mixed with an intoxicating substance, after which she became semi-conscious. The accused allegedly raped her and later threatened to kill her if she disclosed the incident.

Police later announced a reward of ₹25,000 for Prajapati before arresting him on August 11, 2025. The arrest had triggered protests and demonstrations by members of groups including Gau Raksha Dal and Bajrang Dal.

Following the viral videos of the celebratory procession after his release on bail, sharp criticism erupted online over the public glorification of an accused in a serious criminal case.

ACP Masuri Bhaskar Verma stated that police have taken cognisance of the viral footage and launched an investigation into the rally and related activities.

#Ghaziabad #UttarPradesh #SushilPrajapati #ViralVideo #BreakingNews

articles.title: “Goons Storm Lawyer’s Office”: Woman Advocate Dragged by Hair and Assaulted in Jetpur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident raising serious concerns over law and order has emerged from Jetpur city in Gujarat’s Rajkot district, where four women allegedly stormed the office of a woman advocate and brutally assaulted her in broad daylight.

body.html:
A shocking incident raising serious concerns over law and order has emerged from Jetpur city in Gujarat’s Rajkot district, where four women allegedly stormed the office of a woman advocate and brutally assaulted her in broad daylight.

The incident took place at Maruti Complex near Teenbatti Chowk, a busy area in Jetpur, and the entire attack was captured on CCTV cameras installed inside the office. The footage has now gone viral on social media, triggering outrage.

According to reports, advocate Jyoti Makwana was working in her office when four women suddenly entered through the back door and allegedly began abusing her.

Before she could react, the accused allegedly grabbed the lawyer by her hair, dragged her to the ground and assaulted her mercilessly inside the office premises.

People present at the office immediately intervened, rescued the advocate and attempted to calm the situation.

According to the complaint filed by Jyoti Makwana with Jetpur City Police, the attack was linked to an old enmity connected to a divorce case. She stated that she had legally handled the divorce of a man identified as Karan Parmar nearly three months ago, and the accused women allegedly attacked her as part of a pre-planned conspiracy.

Following the incident, Jetpur City Police registered a case against the four accused women and launched action to detain them.

The broad daylight assault inside a lawyer’s office has sparked strong outrage within the Jetpur Bar Association, with lawyers demanding strict action against those involved.

Police are currently investigating the case based on CCTV footage and other evidence.

#Jetpur #Rajkot #LawyerAttack #CCTVFootage #BreakingNews

articles.title: “Phone Call Led to Slaps?”: Viral Video Shows UP Inspector Assaulting Youth Outside Vrindavan Police
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A police inspector posted at the Banke Bihari police station in Vrindavan, Mathura district of Uttar Pradesh, has come under scrutiny after a video showing him allegedly assaulting a young man went viral on social media. The accused officer has been identified as Inspector Subodh Malik.

body.html:
A police inspector posted at the Banke Bihari police station in Vrindavan, Mathura district of Uttar Pradesh, has come under scrutiny after a video showing him allegedly assaulting a young man went viral on social media.

The accused officer has been identified as Inspector Subodh Malik. The victim, identified as Ashish Srivastava, alleged that he was slapped, dragged and beaten without any investigation while passing by the police station on his scooter on Sunday.

According to reports, Ashish had stopped near the police station after receiving a phone call. While he was talking on the phone, Inspector Subodh Malik allegedly grabbed him by the collar and began slapping him in public.

When Ashish questioned the reason for the assault, the inspector reportedly became more aggressive and dragged him towards the police station. During the scuffle, the victim narrowly escaped falling off his scooter.

Ashish further alleged that he was taken inside the police station and assaulted again by police personnel despite informing them that he had a leg injury.

Reports claimed that police staff at the station were at that time questioning a six-year-old boy on suspicion of theft. The inspector allegedly suspected that Ashish was recording a video of the incident, leading to the assault without verification.

The entire incident was reportedly captured on video, which has now gone viral online, triggering outrage and demands for strict action against the officer.

Following the circulation of the footage, CO Sadar Pitam Pal Singh said the matter had come to his notice and an investigation was underway. He stated that appropriate action would be taken after the inquiry report is submitted.

articles.title: “Father or Killer?”: Missing Karnataka Teen Allegedly Murdered by Her Own Father Over Marriage Disp
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking case from Karnataka’s Tumakuru district, a 17-year-old girl who had been missing for more than a month is now suspected to have been murdered by her own father following repeated family disputes over her marriage.

body.html:
In a shocking case from Karnataka’s Tumakuru district, a 17-year-old girl who had been missing for more than a month is now suspected to have been murdered by her own father following repeated family disputes over her marriage.

The victim has been identified as Meghana, a resident of Nimbemaradahalli village in Shira taluk.

According to police, Meghana went missing on April 16 after her mother, Nirmala, returned home from daily wage work around 6:30 pm and could not find her. Her mobile phone was switched off, prompting the family to file a missing complaint.

Investigators said there had been frequent arguments in the family regarding Meghana’s marriage. Nirmala and her relatives were allegedly planning to marry her to a relative’s son after she turned 18. Reports said the groom’s family had already purchased sarees and a mangalsutra for the wedding.

However, Meghana’s father, Thimmarayappa, reportedly opposed the alliance with his wife’s relatives, leading to continuous disputes in the family over the past several months.

Police suspect that Meghana went missing a day after one such argument. Her father also disappeared around the same time, raising suspicion.

According to investigators, Thimmarayappa allegedly confessed during police questioning. Police suspect he pushed Meghana into a well and then threw stones at her before later retrieving her body and burying it in a secluded area.

Officials further stated that after allegedly committing the crime, Thimmarayappa accompanied his wife to the police station and helped file the missing complaint in an attempt to avoid suspicion.

Further investigation is underway.

#Karnataka #Tumakuru #CrimeNews #BreakingNews #MissingGirl

body.html:
A major road accident was captured on CCTV in Andhra Pradesh’s Kakinada district after a speeding car rammed into the parking area of a hotel, causing panic at the scene.

According to reports, the high-speed vehicle crashed into the hotel parking zone with massive force, severely damaging the rear portions of three parked cars.

A hotel security staff member sustained serious injuries in the incident. Locals and staff members immediately rushed to help the injured man before shifting him to Tuni Area Hospital for treatment.

The shocking CCTV footage of the crash has been circulating widely on social media, highlighting the dangers of reckless and overspeeding driving.

Further details regarding the driver and the exact cause of the accident are yet to be officially confirmed.

articles.title: “Disaster Averted in Patna”: Banyan Tree Catches Fire During Vat Savitri Puja, Panic Among Devotees
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major accident was narrowly avoided in Patna during Vat Savitri Puja celebrations after a large banyan tree suddenly caught fire while women were performing rituals around it.

body.html:
A major accident was narrowly avoided in Patna during Vat Savitri Puja celebrations after a large banyan tree suddenly caught fire while women were performing rituals around it.

According to reports, the incident occurred when the flame from a traditional oil lamp allegedly ignited a sacred thread tied around the tree. The fire reportedly spread rapidly within seconds, triggering panic among devotees gathered at the spot.

Eyewitnesses said flames quickly engulfed a large portion of the banyan tree as women participating in the puja rushed away in fear.

Locals and authorities immediately intervened and managed to bring the fire under control before it could lead to a bigger tragedy.

Fortunately, no casualties or serious injuries were reported in the incident.

The incident has once again raised concerns over fire safety arrangements during crowded religious gatherings and traditional ceremonies involving open flames.
